evidence: This trip starts at Aickens car park beside SH73, 5 km west of Otira township.
If Otira River is safe to cross, start from the Aickens car park, cross the stile and follow the fence line to the river.
The trip finishes at the shelter and car park at Windy Point, just off Lewis Pass Highway on SH7.

doubts: Start: the text names 'Aickens car park beside SH73'. Two road ends (F1, F2) where unnamed tracks meet the Otira Highway lie about 1 km from the Aickens place (T7) and the text does not say which is the car park, so the Aickens place is given. End: the text says the car park is 5 minutes down the shingle road at Windy Point, just off Lewis Pass Highway; F3 (where an unnamed track meets Lewis Pass Road, about 800 m from Windy Point) is where the track meets the highway and is not the car park, so the end's ref is Windy Point (T24) and the F3 road end is not used. The walk to the Windy Point car park is recorded as a road way. Fords: 'After crossing the Otira' and the Otehake and Taramakau crossings are recorded as fords; the text says 'may be necessary to cross the Taramakau' below the slip, which is conditional and not recorded. 'continue on over Locke Stream' does not say whether it is bridged, so it has no how. 'After crossing Three Mile Stream' does not say whether it is bridged, so it has no how. Kiwi Hut is reached by a short side-track, so it is a side trip and is not in huts. The Lake Kaurapataka section (6-7 hours or 1-2 days return, with its own loop) is a side trip from Pfeifer Creek, not a second way. The emergency flood track to the Morrison footbridge is not recorded as a way or exit. The eastern side is described on Harper Pass Track (L1), not on this route.
